scientific_question: How did candidates exposed by frozen Phase-3 upward compression alter candidate availability and selection inside frozen original-EME temporal cells?

cell_authority.boundaries: frozen original-EME Voronoi cells from Level-2 scorer
cell_authority.selection_replay: minimum absolute original-time displacement, earlier timestamp, native observation index

metrics: complete candidate timestamps and producer coordinates per cell
candidate count distributions before and after
C2_categories: previous selected coordinate remains but is unselected
E_categories: previous remains and new coordinate displaces
previous disappears and new coordinate selected
previous remains and pre-existing other coordinate selected
D_relationships: cell where previous selection remains observable

metrics: share of processed matched squared displacement
timing_attribution.dominance: largest squared-displacement share, interpreted alongside categorical C2/E evidence

future_intervention_gate.YES: dominant mechanism plus at least one serialized candidate attribute available without original Ground Truth supports a bounded operating principle
future_intervention_gate.INDETERMINATE: mechanism is evidenced but no non-Ground-Truth discriminating attribute is preserved, or authority/replay fails

strength_policy: Report exact serialized strength when present; otherwise UNAVAILABLE_NOT_SERIALIZED_BY_CANONICAL_REPORT
